title: Dissolution of Business Partnership Agreement

signers.label: Court Authority
signers.note: Filled automatically at approval — not part of the intake handoff flow.

notes: Reuses the same partner1/partner2/business_name/business_address/effective_date keys as business_partnership.json for consistency across the two related documents.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.prompt: What date does this dissolution take effect?

fields.label: Business Address
fields.prompt: What is the business's principal address?

fields.label: Partner 1 CID
fields.prompt: What is Partner 1's CID? If this is you, run /cid in city — it copies your CID to your clipboard, paste it here. If you don't have it, answer "Unknown".

fields.label: Partner 1 Address
fields.prompt: What is Partner 1's address? (Answer "Unknown" if you don't have it.)

fields.label: Partner 2 CID
fields.prompt: What is Partner 2's CID? If this is you, run /cid in city — it copies your CID to your clipboard, paste it here. If you don't have it, answer "Unknown".

fields.label: Partner 2 Address
fields.prompt: What is Partner 2's address? (Answer "Unknown" if you don't have it.)

fields.label: Requesting Partner
fields.prompt: Which partner is requesting this dissolution — Partner 1, Partner 2, or Both Partners?

fields.label: Cessation Basis
fields.prompt: Why is this partnership ending? Choose one: Voluntary Withdrawal (a partner is choosing to leave), Involuntary Withdrawal (a partner is being removed — e.g. death, incapacity, misconduct), or Dissolution (the business itself is closing).

fields.label: Involuntary Withdrawal Reason
fields.prompt: What is the reason for the involuntary withdrawal? Choose one: Death of a Partner, Partner Incapacitated, Incompetence or Negligence, Breach of Fiduciary Duties, Criminal or Civil Judgment, or Other Breach of Agreement.

fields.label: Further Details
fields.prompt: Provide further details about this dissolution.

fields.label: Dissolution Type
fields.prompt: Which type of dissolution is this? Choose one: Single Owner Operation (the business continues under one remaining partner), Sold to a New Partner (ownership transfers to someone new), or Business Will Cease to Operate (the business shuts down entirely).

fields.label: New Partner Name
fields.prompt: What is the new partner's full name?

fields.label: New Partner CID
fields.prompt: What is the new partner's CID? If this is you, run /cid in city — it copies your CID to your clipboard, paste it here. If you don't have it, answer "Unknown".

fields.label: New Partner Address
fields.prompt: What is the new partner's address? (Answer "Unknown" if you don't have it.)

fields.label: Partner 1 Signature
fields.note: Collected from Partner 1 directly. Filled via the separate document hand-off/signature-routing system after the filer submits -- not asked during intake.

fields.label: Partner 2 Signature
fields.note: Collected from Partner 2 directly. Filled via the separate document hand-off/signature-routing system after the filer submits -- not asked during intake.

fields.label: Court Authority Signature
fields.note: Rendered in cursive. Filled in by the bot when the DOJ accepts the dissolution — never asked of the partners.
